compatibility_control_scope: Complete selected modules; no subset by substring. Exact JUnit case names are source-derived and collection-guarded by full identity multiset.
dependency_method: Static import and selected fixture/call-path closure; 22 pinned APP uv.lock packages with complete wheel hash allowlists, isolated pip --no-deps --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes.
not_included_or_asserted: No production registry compilation or stack launch
No live /proc read, embedder reload, live process environment, request endpoint, model, inference, or benchmark
No policy mutation; selected controls use temporary/fake state and existing unit behavior
recipe_revision: bound by hosted workflow github.sha and native receipt repository identity
recipe_source_scope: Same source population rule for APP, carrier, and recipe; source map itself is an explicit read input and bound by the clean recipe Git commit.
scope: prospective synthetic hosted test execution; source identity/readset only
source_population_rule: All tracked .py/.yaml/.yml/.toml files; all tracked files under config/; explicit lockfiles, package manifests, pytest/tool config, and requirements*.txt; path set reconstructed from pinned Git trees and runtime-set-checked. Tracked symlinks are pinned by link-text SHA-256 and target string; external targets are identity-only.
